Name: will's Wizard Catalogue
Author: plaidbees
Description:
[size=4][center][size=5]will's Wizard Catalogue[/size][/center][/size]This was originally my first Stardew project. I finished 90% of the tilesheet, and then proceeded to get distracted making something else. Having learned how to actually made mods, I returned to this to create an absurd amount of config options, courtesy of my own indecisiveness. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] is [u]highly[/u] recommended.

[center][size=5]Furniture Options[/size][/center][list]
[*]Each furniture item has its own config option, or multiple options in certain cases. The purple detailing can be enabled/disabled for each item, each book's shade chosen, stone shade chosen for each item, you get the point.
[*]The plants and Tower Painting change colors seasonally by default, or can be made to stay any of the four colors.
[*]Books in the study can be changed to match the randomized pattern of the rest of the bookshelves. Defaults to false.
[*]Dots can be removed from the Elixir tables, Tea table, and Decorative door. Defaults to false.
[*]The broom handle can match either the black furniture or the trees. Defaults to brown.
[*]Stone furniture items have three available shades. All default to medium.
[*]Detailing on certain furniture can be made purple. All default to on.
[*]The cups on the tea table can be removed or changed in color.
[*]The books and crystal balls have a lighter and darker shade.
[/list]And thats it! Shoutout to the Stardew discord server's modding channels for the encouragement that got me to finally get this mod published. Its literally been done for days, I just didn't want to write the mod page. [size=1](And i still ended up wasting time drawing a Mothman for the header to put it off)[/size]
